text: Based on Earth-observation evidence, this property is **not legally compliant regarding forests**. Satellite data shows no forest cover (0%) as of 2020 (JRC GFC2020), despite having tree cover in 2000. Significant deforestation occurred before 2020, with 98.8 hectares of tree-cover loss recorded between 2008 and 2020. While minor loss (0.4 ha) occurred after 2020, it was below the 0.5-ha event threshold and thus not counted. The asset appears to have been largely deforested prior to the 2020 baseline, violating forest protection requirements.
